name: Iron Curtain
desc: Enemies deal 10% less damage.

name: Opening Salvo
desc: Battle start: hit a random enemy for 50% max HP and a random hero for 20% max HP.

name: Bulwark Projector
desc: Enemy phase start: 3 shield to all heroes.

name: Nanite Field
desc: Enemy phase start: heal 3 HP to all heroes.

name: Caustic Disperser
desc: All enemies start with 3 burn for the battle.

name: Overcharge
desc: Hero attacks deal 10% more damage.

name: Signal Interference
desc: -2 to all enemy rolls.

name: Coordinated Strike
desc: +2 to all hero rolls.

name: Thermal Catalyst
desc: Enemy burn deals +2 damage per tick.

name: Gravity Well
desc: Enemy phase start: 2 damage to all enemies.

name: Supply Bypass
desc: Items are free. +1 Protocol per use, except Protocol items.

name: Attrition Field
desc: From battle 6: enemies start at 85% HP or less.

name: Chain Reaction
desc: Enemy dies: 4 damage to all other enemies. Cannot chain itself.

name: Vengeance Order
desc: Hero falls: all survivors roll 20 next turn. Once per battle.

name: Overload Loop
desc: Hero abilities on a 20 activate twice.

name: Priority Cache
desc: Rewards exclude common consumables.

name: Reserve Capacitor
desc: Carry 50% of unused Protocol to the next battle.

name: Field Cache
desc: Battle start: gain 1 random consumable if space allows.

name: Revival Matrix
desc: Revive heroes at 100% HP.

name: Emergency Signal
desc: Hero crosses to 50% HP or less: +2 to all next hero rolls. Once per battle.

name: Aegis Field
desc: Friendly healing restores HP: 3 shield to all heroes.

name: Standing Order
desc: Each hero's fourth ability starts 1 die value lower.

name: Static Field
desc: First round: jam all enemy dice.

name: Overflow Vent
desc: Each excess Protocol: 2 damage to a random enemy.

name: Salvage Directive
desc: Kill with a mark-boosted hit: +2 Protocol.

name: Cold Logic
desc: Hero attacks: +4 damage vs frozen enemies.

name: Chain Doctrine
desc: Hero chains jump to 1 more enemy.

name: Scavenger Manifest
desc: First enemy death each battle: gain 1 consumable if space allows.

name: Dead Man's Hand
desc: On a squad wipe: revive all at 1 HP; next rolls are 20. Once per run.

name: Salvage Rig
desc: Break an enemy shield with an attack: +1 Protocol.

name: Chitin Graft
desc: Hero kills an enemy: heal that hero 3 HP.

name: Resonant Chorus
desc: First-round hero dice roll at least 8.

name: Root Access
desc: First Set each battle is free.

name: Mantle Core
desc: Hero shields last until depleted or removed.
